scope: Test whether GTK2's public range API can classify the endpoint direction independently from whole-widget sensitivity, and inspect the style callbacks available to a renderer.

findings.gtk_style_callbacks: GtkStyle draw_box receives widget, detail and state. The GTK2 range callback currently reports hscrollbar/vscrollbar as detail; draw_arrow additionally receives GtkArrowType. Logs confirmed the lower/upper disabled stepper tracks the adjustment endpoints and GTK's inverted flag.
findings.public_classifier: A classifier using GtkRange inversion, lower/upper stepper sensitivity policy and GtkAdjustment bounds distinguishes an AUTO endpoint from a whole insensitive widget. GTK_SENSITIVITY_OFF/ON are not reclassified.
findings.position_details: GTK 2.24.33 defines GtkRange:stepper-position-details, but the isolated GTK RC attempt did not activate it (gtk_widget_style_get remained false). Therefore positional detail delivery to a real theme engine remains unproven.
findings.rendering_limit: The classifier test does not install or implement a GTK theme engine and does not prove pixel output. draw_box lacks arrow direction in the current default details; a real engine must prove per-stepper box identification before changing the disabled endpoint cell.

tests.result: PASS 19 endpoint direction/policy/sensitivity classifications; no drawing or input mutation.

source_analysis.details: gtkrange.c lines 5813-5874 select GTK_STATE_INSENSITIVE for either whole-widget sensitivity or disabled lower/upper stepper. GtkStyle draw_box exposes widget/detail; draw_arrow also exposes direction. The GtkRange position-detail style property is documented in gtkrange.c lines 4648-4663.

limits: No pixel comparison against the generated GTK2 role assets was run in this step.
No real custom theme engine was compiled or loaded.
No input was sent; R513 already records that clicks at the blocked endpoints leave the adjustment unchanged.
No Domain/OS VM screenshot or user visual acceptance was added.
next: Prototype the actual GTK2 theme-engine integration privately, first proving per-stepper position details or a safe geometry discriminator for both box and arrow drawing. Compare endpoint paint to normal role assets while asserting whole-widget-insensitive paint remains disabled and endpoint input stays blocked.
